name: Grey Ridge x402 Market Data
description: Hosted DeFi and crypto market-data server exposing 26 tools over MCP: live token prices, DEX/perp funding rates, DeFi yields, prediction-market odds, Base-chain RPC reads (block/gas/balance/receipt/token metadata), domain/tech-risk enrichment, pre-trade token-safety gates (honeypot and rug checks for Base ERC-20s), and MCP-server security scanning. tools/list and free-preview responses are unauthenticated; data-returning calls are pay-per-call via the x402 protocol (USDC on Base, $0.001-$0.05 per call) settled over an HTTP 402 challenge, so no account or API key is provisioned. Base-only chain reads.
author: Grey Ridge Signals
